title: World's Roundest Object!
beats: Presenter is allowed to hold a one-kilogram silicon sphere, treated like a sacred object
Scale of the sphere: 2.15e25 atoms, worth a million euros raw, priceless once sculpted
If this were Earth, mountain-to-valley would be 14 m: roundness made felt by scaling up
Why spend this much? Answer deferred into a history of the word grave and the French Revolution
Kilogram defined as a litre of ice water; name clash with aristocratic graf; Lavoisier loses his head
Gramme too small, return to grave, rename kilogram: why only SI base unit with a prefix
Definition refined: water at 4C, then platinum cylinder, then Le Grand K; artifact is by definition the kilogram
Le Grand K: only thing with mass exactly 1 kg, three bell jars, three keys, Paris vault
How would anyone know if Big K changed? Replicas compared in 1948 and 40 years later had drifted up to 50 micrograms
Cause of drift unknown; unit that changes is unacceptable; four SI base units depend on it
Jab at non-metric countries: their pound is defined via the kilogram
How does a sphere help? Interview: count atoms by calculation, not by counting
Perfect single-isotope crystal, so atom count follows from size; sphere because one diameter fixes volume
Make it: start oversized by 2 mm, grind finer, massaging atoms
Measure diameter with laser in a cavity, get volume, divide by known atom spacing to count atoms, fix Avogadro constant
Definition could read as a number of silicon-28 atoms; rival Watt Balance route, two checks on each other, maybe 2014
How good was the original water definition? Off by 25 mg, a grain of rice, in 214 years
Watt Balance offered if viewers ask; Lavoisier pun closes the arc, cradle to grave

theory: The video makes a tiny technical fix feel necessary by first telling the story of the unit and then showing the unit failing. The sphere is introduced only after the learner feels the problem, so it lands as a solution rather than a curiosity.
velocity: Orchestrator: delay the solution beat until a failure beat (drifting replicas) has been shown; do not open with the mechanism
Scene builder: add a rescale-to-familiar scene type (sphere to Earth) for any extreme precision number
Voice: humour and story beats keep a flat wpm without feeling dense; log them as pacing beats
quote: how would anyone ever know if the mass of Big K changed
